response.text: I'm currently a Senior Cloud DevOps Engineer at Infometics, where UBA Group (United Bank for Africa) is one of our key clients. I architect and lead the implementation of secure, scalable cloud infrastructure. My primary project has been building a production-grade, highly available Kubernetes cluster on AWS in our development environment to validate stateful IBM workloads in a simulated, air-gapped environment.
response.voiceText: I'm a Senior Cloud DevOps Engineer at Infometics. UBA Group is one of our key clients. I build secure, scalable cloud infrastructure and Kubernetes clusters.

data.title: Production-Grade K8s Cluster for IBM Workloads
data.description: A highly available, multi-master (3-node) Kubernetes cluster on AWS in development environment, designed to simulate a secure on-premise environment. Features zero-trust networking, software-defined storage, and full disaster recovery.
achievements: Re-architected legacy IBM applications (ACE/MQ) as StatefulSets
Proved workloads can run reliably in cloud-native, secure environment
